headline: Embassy Buildcon files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in WeWork India
sum: Embassy Buildcon has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code Regulation 31(4) in respect of WeWork India Management Limited; exact acquisition percentage, value and structure not disclosed in available sources.
detail: The NSE filing confirms a Regulation 31(4) disclosure has been lodged, which indicates Embassy Buildcon has crossed or intends to cross a substantial shareholding threshold in WeWork India. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code mandates disclosure of acquisition, and typically signals entry into an open offer or negotiated settlement. Precise acquisition percentage, consideration, and transaction structure remain undisclosed in accessible filings.
